title: 汽車渦輪增壓器工程
summary: 以氣路與轉子兩條故事線連結壓力比、熱量、平衡及工作點邊界。
summaryEn: Join gas-path and rotor storylines through pressure ratio, heat, balance and map boundaries.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 壓縮機壓力比：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Compressor pressure ratio: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 壓縮機壓力比 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Compressor pressure ratio and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為渦輪轉子、壓縮機葉輪與中冷器。壓力比使用絕對壓力；壓縮機工作點還需要流量、轉速與效率。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows turbine rotor, compressor impeller and intercooler. Pressure ratio uses absolute pressure; a compressor point also needs flow, speed and efficiency.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：PR=pout,abs/pin,abs；pout=200 kPa、pin=100 kPa；計算結果=2 1。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: PR=pout,abs/pin,abs; pout=200 kPa, pin=100 kPa; result=2 1.
steps.failure: 壓力降低可能是洩漏、控制或進氣限制；先對比上下游壓力和流量。
steps.failureEn: Low pressure may mean leakage, control or intake restriction; compare both pressures and flow.
steps.check: PR=2；以表壓相除會得到錯誤結果。 將此判讀連回渦輪轉子、壓縮機葉輪與中冷器的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: PR is 2; dividing gauge pressures gives the wrong result. Relate this interpretation to turbine rotor, compressor impeller and intercooler and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.

knowledge.text: 在試算表、紙面剖面或自行準備的離線教學模型中：在假想壓縮機圖放置轉速線和工作點，辨識喘振與阻塞邊界僅為示意。 交付物：本單元計算表、可重現條件與一項尚無法判定的結論。

steps.title: 理想壓縮溫升：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Ideal compression temperature: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 理想壓縮溫升 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Ideal compression temperature and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為渦輪轉子、壓縮機葉輪與中冷器。等熵理想氣體式給無損壓縮基準；實際效率小於1時出口溫度更高。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows turbine rotor, compressor impeller and intercooler. The isentropic ideal-gas relation gives a lossless baseline; real efficiency below one raises outlet temperature.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：T2=T1 PR^((gamma-1)/gamma)；T1=300 K、PR=2、gamma=1.4；計算結果=365.7041 K。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: T2=T1 PR^((gamma-1)/gamma); T1=300 K, PR=2, gamma=1.4; result=365.7041 K.
steps.failure: 溫度感測位置和熱浸會改變讀值；對齊穩態與探頭位置。
steps.failureEn: Sensor placement and heat soak affect readings; align steady conditions and probe location.
steps.check: 理想T2約365.704 K；不得把攝氏溫度直接代入絕對溫度比。 將此判讀連回渦輪轉子、壓縮機葉輪與中冷器的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Ideal T2 is about 365.704 K; Celsius cannot be used in absolute temperature ratios. Relate this interpretation to turbine rotor, compressor impeller and intercooler and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.
